hook.text: 'We'll match any lower price!' Sounds customer-friendly. It's actually a signal to competitors.

buildup.text: The message to rivals: 'Don't bother cutting prices. We'll match instantly, so you won't steal our customers.'

discovery.text: Price matching softens competition. If everyone matches, nobody gains from cutting. Prices stay high.

twist.text: Economists showed that price matching can function as tacit collusion—without any secret agreement.

climax.text: Regulators struggle: the policy looks pro-consumer, but its strategic effect is anti-competitive.

quiz.question: What is the hidden strategic effect of price matching?
options: It discourages rivals from cutting prices
